title: Norway – self-preparedness
disclaimer: Official guidance is translated into HomePrep planning primitives. Personal circumstances always take precedence.

sources.title: How to contribute to Norway's emergency preparedness

recommendations.title: Stored emergency water
recommendations.advisory_note: DSB recommends storing around 20 litres of drinking water per person, intended to cover minimum needs for one week.
recommendations.household_adjustment_note: The 20-litre recommendation is per person. Individual circumstances may justify a larger personal target.
recommendations.pet_adjustment_note: Pet water is not included in this numeric recommendation; add a separate personal target when relevant.

requirements.label: I can prepare food without mains electricity
requirements.description: Confirm when your household has a usable alternative cooking method.

requirements.label: My household can stay warm if normal heating stops
requirements.description: Confirm when you have a practical plan and supplies for retaining warmth.

recommendations.title: Battery, crank or solar emergency lighting

requirements.label: Working emergency lighting is available without mains power

recommendations.title: DAB radio independent of mains power

requirements.label: A working DAB radio can be used without mains power

recommendations.title: Extra regular medicine reserve
recommendations.condition_note: Relevant when someone uses regular medication.
recommendations.advisory_note: DSB advises at least a seven-day extra supply of medicines and medical equipment used regularly.

recommendations.condition_note: Relevant when the household has pets.
